title: ptarmica × valesiaca
intro: Ptarmica × valesiaca, commonly known as hybrid feverfew, is a perennial plant in the daisy family that is native to Europe. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of migraines and other headaches due to its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ptarmica × valesiaca include its analgesic, antiemetic, and antipyretic effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ptarmica × valesiaca include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
